notes.title: Major Update: New Roles and More
notes.content:
Hello Jungle Nation!

This month, we have some exciting new updates including our first gameplay updates that adds new roles to the game. Thank you for your continued support by playing the game and providing feedback. It greatly helps us in making a better game and sharing the great party game experience that we all enjoy with more players!

[b]What's New:
[/b]

[b]- Three New Roles:[/b] Take your games to a whole new level of depth and introduce a new level of mind games and twists to your gameplay.

    - Trustee: a Loyalist who sees two suspects. One of them is the Agent, the other one is the Faker, but it's not clear who's who.
    - Faker: a Leaker who can use this position to trick the Trustee and earn his trust.
    - Mole: the only Leaker that is not seen by the Agent.

[b]- Coin Toss[/b]
Coin toss allows you to leave your vote up to the chances, only once per game. A new fun way to play mind games when voting. Everyone sees the coin toss, so you can use it to blow off some heat by not accepting responsibility about the outcome and feel like a true politician.


[b]- Easy Game Restart[/b]
You can now restart the game with the same players after it's finished, so you don't have to join in again. You will be taken to the lobby where you can immediately start a new game, or change the game config or add/remove players.

[b]- More Tutorial Slides (web app)[/b]
We added more visual slides to our tutorial in the web app (jungle.buzz) to make it easier for you learn and review the rules. We’ll continue to invest more here to make it easy for you invite new friends to your games!

[b]- MacOS Port[/b]
Adding to the Linux support last month, you can now play Republic of Jungle on your MacOS devices too. The Desktop realm is complete! Wait for exciting news about our upcoming platforms...

[b]- Small Bug Fixes[/b]
As usual, you report bugs, we squash them!

Cheers,
Team Gerdoo

notes.title: Republic of Jungle: Update and Pricing Announcement
notes.content:
Hello, Jungle Nation

We hope you've enjoyed sneaking, strategizing, and outsmarting your friends and foes alike in the dense foliage of Republic of Jungle. Our month-long free promotion has come to an end, and we want to thank everyone who joined us on this wild adventure. Your enthusiasm and feedback have been incredibly valuable, and we're excited to announce that Republic of Jungle will now be a paid product on Steam. This transition marks a new chapter for us, and with it, we're rolling out some exciting updates to enhance your gameplay experience.

[b]What's New:[/b]
[b]- Educational Tutorial Slides:[/b] We've launched new tutorial slides available on jungle.buzz. These slides are designed to guide you through the basics and dive into the advanced rules of the game, making it easier for both new recruits and seasoned veterans to thrive in the jungle.

[b]- Linux Port:[/b] By popular demand, we're thrilled to announce that Republic of Jungle is now available on Linux! Dive into the game on your preferred platform. And for our MacOs users, hang tight – your version is on its way soon.

[b]- Enhanced Localization:[/b] We've expanded our localization coverage and implemented fixes to make Republic of Jungle more accessible and enjoyable for players around the globe. Your feedback has been instrumental, and we're committed to continuing these improvements.

[b]- Bug Fixes:[/b] We've squashed some pesky bugs that were lurking in the underbrush. These fixes aim to provide a smoother and more stable gameplay experience for all.

Looking Forward:
As we transition Republic of Jungle to a paid product, we're more committed than ever to supporting our community and delivering an unforgettable gaming experience. These updates are just the beginning – we have plenty more in store for you. 

We want to extend our heartfelt thanks to everyone who participated in our free promotion. Your support and feedback have been the driving force behind these updates. If you've enjoyed your time in the jungle and want to continue supporting us, consider writing us a positive review on Steam. This would help us a lot!

Stay wild and civil!

- Gerdoo Team

notes.title: Introducing the All New Republic of Jungle
notes.content:
[h1]Welcome, Jungle Nation! [/h1]

[previewyoutube=iqzS9vWXm_Q;full][/previewyoutube]

We're thrilled to be back with an exciting Republic of Jungle dev log. Let's dive into the latest updates we've been working on.

[h2]1. Updated UI Designs: [/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38705137/bf350c68368d330aab93e19e9a82e77e3b6752d4.png[/img]
Our talented UI artist, Erfan, has been hard at work to make the game more accessible and user-friendly, particularly for beginners. You'll notice clearer outcomes of tasks and the all-new leader board, this shows the history of task leaders, as well as whose team got approved and whose got rejected. Allowing the player to easily keep track of people’s suspicious choices.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38705137/9927d6832c65b10de206f0c0331e9089f1b8bba9.png[/img]

[h2]2. Enhanced Visual Style[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38705137/2a36e3b1edf38223c9328ed96b3fb6d340605a3d.png[/img]
To provide a richer and more immersive experience, we've added animated transitions to the flow of the game. Prepare to witness the visual upgrade and renaming of the Wiretap and Confide mechanics to "power plays." These changes showcase the depths the Loyalists will go to protect their president.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38705137/9193e7e02dc69956ab35f83c54d82200c0b28ac1.jpg[/img]

[h2]3. Improved Controller Layout[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38705137/525d15eaae17494bd3ce3b937ea1b1d595f3389d.jpg[/img]
We understand the importance of quick decision-making. That's why we've been diligently working on a new controller layout. It will provide you with easy access to crucial information, ensuring you can make game-changing decisions at a glance. Please note that we're still fine-tuning the final look, so expect some minor differences in the build.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38705137/854abe49394069a92786e14aee28809c5fffa5b5.jpg[/img]

[h2]4. Introducing the RoJ Discord App[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38705137/3f953936d7d55114de2ff4fabbaad5a82fc4446c.png[/img]
We're excited to announce the development of the RoJ Discord App. This innovative app allows you to control the game directly within your Discord community, without the need to open a browser. It's a seamless experience for both desktop and mobile players. Community leaders can add the app to their servers, enabling groups to learn and play the game together.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38705137/c90327fa663ee87584e594acb000266f9875baea.png[/img]

[h2]5. Search for RoJ Events
[/h2]
The RoJ Discord App features a powerful search function. You can easily find in-action or planned upcoming RoJ events across our partner servers. This function allows us to promote our partner servers and shows you where and when you can join a game of RoJ. Stay tuned for a special event announcement in the near future!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38705137/320b9105dd42afc6169907ab788d43018d7251cc.jpg[/img]

We appreciate your patience and support throughout the game's development. Creating RoJ has been a monumental task, and your enthusiasm motivates us to make it the best it can be. Don't forget to wishlist the game on Steam—it greatly helps us spread the word and reach more players.

Thank you, Jungle Nation, for being a part of this incredible journey. We'll be back soon with more exciting updates!

notes.title: A Look at 2022
notes.content:
[h1][b]Happy Holiday Season Jungle Nation[/b]
[/h1]
From expanding the team to launching the closed beta, we've had a super busy year and we couldn't be more proud of how far the game has come this year alone. 

With 2022 drawing to a close we thought we'd take a moment to reflect upon the past year of development, highlighting some of the key moments, and taking a look at what it took to get to where we are today.

So without further ado, this was 2022...

[h2][b]The Team Grew[/b]
[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38705137/d2774b6b3038d4d4d7d28025b284bc942622dbbc.png[/img]

At the start of the year, we expanded Team Gerdoo, adding Jarvis as our Marketing and Community Director. She brought with her experience of managing the communities of several indie games, as well as of a huge YouTube channel in the UK, PlayStation Access. For a community-based game like ours, this was an important role to fill and according to you guys, we definitely made the right choice in bringing Jarvs on board. 

She has been a key member of the team this year and we're glad you seem to love her as much as we do.

[h2][b]The Big Update[/b]
[/h2]

For most of the year, the team was hard at work updating the game prior to the launch of our closed beta. We wanted to overhaul pretty much everything bar the core gameplay loop itself, which was no small undertaking, to say the least. 

A great deal of coding needed to be rewritten, and whilst we won't bore you with the details, trust us it was a long but fun process.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38705137/4afd5be276cf62759575b70d18f702346a493101.png[/img]

Our artist Naeim did an incredible job redesigning the characters, developing a completely new art style for the game in the process.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38705137/e9b04f92858fdc65ca03c8251b216931318aaa50.png[/img]

The feedback from the community on the new art style has been wonderful, and we cannot wait to show you all what he's been working on in recent months as well.

At the same time as the characters were being given new life, our UI/UX Designer Erfan was busy overhauling the UI to change the way the game feels to play, making it more accessible for players and easier to follow from a viewer's standpoint. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38705137/b317e0b60cc6e74d1867a762acefa882e3dab750.png[/img]

The little flourishes he added, such as the candid scandal photos in the secret files or the species info of each character, continue to be fan favourites and we are so grateful for his incredible work this year.
We honestly can't believe just how different the game looks now from the start of 2022.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38705137/ffd19961ca3ea85d6852afc10884f166469dab67.png[/img]

We also knew that, with the big update underway, we needed new marketing materials to reflect the changes to the game's look. 

Work began on several iterations of possible new logos and whilst it took us a while to settle on the final designs, we absolutely fell in love with the new key art Naeim produced. It gave us confidence going into our first big in-person event of the year, that the look of the game was strong enough to attract new players who previously knew nothing about it. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38705137/c9d3544c1fb9ae575f32b41f0b5206eac59a6ac9.png[/img] 

[h2][b]EGX London[/b]
[/h2]

With Jarvs being based in Europe we were able to attend EGX London this year, without the need for trans-Atlantic travel, making it the first time RoJ would be shown at a big in-person event outside of the US.

A lot of preparation went into our presence at the show as we knew this would be our biggest opportunity to get more people to sign-up to play the closed beta.

We hired an intern, Jerreau, just for EGX, who helped Jarvs and her partner to run our booth on the show floor. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38705137/8191e491da43646159e364058063d48cd492b397.jpg[/img]

We had everything from merch to giveaway, to a [url=https://www.tiktok.com/@republicofjungle]TikTok[/url] treasure hunt, to beta sign-up forms and the game on display for people to see, at the booth and we were inundated with people wanting to know more. 

We had some great conversations with eventgoers and even managed to make some new friends, whilst telling people about the game.

But the booth wasn't our only focus for the event as Jarvs also managed to wrangle two stage appearances across the weekend. 

The first being a talk on careers in the games industry, titled [i]Finding What You CAN Do
[/i], on the Barclay's Rezzed stage, on the Saturday. It was well attended and we are honoured that she spoke about how much working on RoJ has meant to her as a disabled dev.  We always try to be inclusive in all that we do here at Gerdoo Games, so to hear a member of the team speak about what that has meant to them really made us smile. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38705137/bb1b7257fa57670b14e909fe02074331c0f18b38.png[/img]

The second stage appearance was to show off the new beta, in all its upgraded glory, to the audience of the EGX Main Stage. 

Jarv was joined on stage by Twitch Partners Captain Badgertail and Nikoheart, as well as Psy White, Scott Tailford and Jules Gill from YouTube's WhatCutlure Gaming, for a few rounds of RoJ. Chaos ensued, as we're sure you can imagine, and the audience laughed all throughout the show.

Almost every single person watching that day signed-up for the closed beta and we were blown away by the love and support given to the game across the entire event. 

[h2][b]Launching the Closed Beta[/b]
[/h2]

That brings us to the launch of the closed beta this November. The culmination of all the team's hard work since the start of 2022. 

Everyone who signed up during EGX or had previously backed our Kickstarter campaign received an email inviting them to take part in the new phase of beta testing, and we sat back, nervously awaiting their first impressions.

The feedback soon came rolling in and we were delighted to hear that you loved the new look of RoJ as much as we did. You let us know what you liked, where the bugs were and gave important opinions of the subtle changes to the gameplay.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38705137/02f71614eb1baacdd8a624c37dc187c71590ef80.png[/img]

Each week Jarvs ran an RoJ game night in our [url=https://discord.gg/nPF97TV7Xk]Discord[/url] server, which quickly became a regular hangout for our core community. There she was able to get valuable feedback on the beta, which she then relayed to the rest of the team, in order for us to iterate on and improve your experience when playing the game. 

We encourage more of you to join the game nights too, because not a single one has ended without at least one person crying with laughter, and we challenge you to name a better way to end your week than laughing with friends over a good game. Plus, the more feedback we get whilst in beta, the better the final product will be.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38705137/f9ea38def4bb048731edeef6b9ae949eb81bcfb8.jpg[/img]

One of the things that we mentioned earlier which was continually commented on during the early beta game nights, was the inclusion of the characters' species in the UI. Out of this, the community suggested it would be nice for us to do a fundraiser for an animal preservation charity, if possible, and we took this to heart.

So, we got in touch with The Humane Society of America. They loved the fact that our game has no violence towards animals and we loved the work they do on their Black Beauty Ranch in Texas, rescuing animals of all kinds, from tigers to kangaroos, to the tiniest of kittens. So, together we planned a stream as part of their December Dash in order to help raise money for the ranch to continue to support the animals in their care.

We smashed our original goal of $100 making three times that in the end, and had the best time working with them. We look forward to working together on future fundraisers in 2023.

[h2][b]Thank You[/b][/h2]

A huge thank you to every single person who has shown an interest in RoJ this year. Your support inspires us to do what we do, and we can't wait to share more with you in the new year. 

Don't forget that it's not too late to get access to the beta for yourself. All you need to do is head to the Republic of Jungle [url=https://republicofjungle.com/]website[/url] and sign-up to get a place on the waitlist and we will email you as soon as more slots become available.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38705137/c383c12d9455577c5b66ad09bcb42cea20632f99.png[/img]

We hope you have a wonderful holiday season whatever you get up to.
See you all in the new year, when we'll have even more updates to share with you.
But for now...

...[b]Thank you Jungle Nation and here's to a great 2023![/b]

Team Gerdoo Games.

notes.title: We're Going to EGX London This September
notes.content:
[h1][b]We're super excited to announce that we're heading to EGX this September![/b][/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38705137/ea340c54e370689294879fdbb97c745e30684657.png[/img]

Hearing from you directly about your experience with Republic of Jungle is invaluable to us as developers. So, we're genuinely extremely excited to get to go to an in-person event again and to hopefully meet some of you there. 

We will post a map of our position on the show floor closer to the event, so keep an eye out for that.

[h2]Streamers and Content Creators[/h2]

If you're thinking of playing Republic of Jungle on stream, we want to help. We'd love to chat with you about how we can make streaming RoJ as seamless as possible. 

We will be taking the names of those who would like to make Republic of Jungle content at our booth, across EGX, so drop by and let us know if you're thinking of doing so. 

We will also be opening applications to join our Ambassador Programme (more details to follow soon) on the first day of the event and will be giving exclusive RoJ merch to those who apply, whilst stocks last. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38705137/f29754fcbbc4ef8d986cb1c8f91ada761c37f1ae.png[/img]

[h2]It's Showtime![/h2]

On the Sunday we'll be live on the EGX Stage where our Jarvis will be joined by WhatCulture Gaming's Scott Tailford, Jules Gil & James Dowsee, plus Twitch Partner Nikoheart.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38705137/95f91114e522ea6284134c76d95e8894ee52af37.png[/img]

Head to the stage area for 1:30 pm to watch us reveal the brand new version of Republic of Jungle LIVE!

We will be playing a couple of rounds with the boys and can already foresee the chaos that will unfold. Trust us, you won't want to miss this!

Then we will be adding a couple of players to the roster when we ask two people from the audience to join us on stage to play one final round with us.

We may even have a few things to giveaway during the show...who knows?

[h2]Hope to See You There[/h2]

We'd love to meet you all. So, please do find us at our booth to say hello or join us for a [i]meet and greet[/i] after our show on Sunday, where you'll get the chance to meet Nikoheart and the WhatCulture Gaming guys and to chat to Jarvis about Republic of Jungle, should you have any questions.

Looking forward to meeting you all.

Team Gerdoo Games.

notes.title: Dev Log #4 - Thinking Outside the Fox
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38705137/fdb8563c72191bca3de09a7e1dafd9792723bb6a.png[/img]

Hello everyone, and welcome to our 4th Dev Log! Today we’re gonna talk some more about the UI rework, show off the Fiona Fox rework, touch base on some game mechanics, and more upcoming community events! Now, let’s dive into it, shall we?

[h1]UI/UX:[/h1]
Erfan, our UX designer has finalized the new character card designs, and we have started adding them to the game engine.

He also started working on the new design for “operation folders''. More info on the folders will be shown in the near future, but what we will say is that they are not only going to indicate the number of players needed in the task force, but a lot more! Here’s a first look:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38705137/72507709b66b92966222841481fb7419c6b1866f.png[/img]

There are a lot of changes we want to make to the trial phase, the end summary, and the initial loadout, so more to come on that.

[h1]Art:[/h1]
Naeem, our game artist, was primarily busy with the character redesign for Fiona Fox, who is President Puma’s antagonist and one of the 2 main characters of the game. We believe she’s coming along nicely:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38705137/1a6e653f422283bbfec7d0226bd51a5b84063573.jpg[/img]

He’s also been busy creating the new loadout screen (the starting screen where everyone joins the game), showing off some Bite House staff striking poses!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38705137/555c64000f9d960830f285149b5270d7917d8b14.jpg[/img]

[h1]Game Design:[/h1]
One of the discussions that came up a lot this past month was how we could have different achievements and recognition badges for players. Our brainstorming sessions had some excellent results, and we now have a better idea about what we can do in this area.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38705137/4511ba087959227fdc37c786ff2053dab77c5848.png[/img]

With that said, there’s a lot of different challenges and scenarios that we want to add to the game to add some replayability value for the veterans. 

[h1]Tech:[/h1]
We are making great progress on the tech side. The code for the new server and the new backend API is coming along nicely, and we have already connected this new backend infrastructure to Unity.

Last but not least, a big point of focus has been the code’s testability, and we are aiming to make this new infrastructure much more testable than what we had before. This means that you as players will see much less game-breaking bugs and issues in the future, making the game experience smoother for everyone!

[h1]Community:[/h1]
We are glad to announce that our last community Game Night was yet again a blast, hosted by our dear [url=https://www.twitch.tv/shissan]Melfice[/url]! You can check out the vod [url=https://www.twitch.tv/videos/1292016027?filter=archives&sort=time]here[/url]. More events are coming, so if you missed the opportunity to test the game before, make sure to check our socials and to join our [url=https://discord.gg/Mg7V8C9E2M]Discord[/url] so you can join us on the next Game Night!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38705137/1647ca585145a31f4464ea2b9b4b071bde91c515.jpg[/img]

That is all for this month, friends! Thanks for reading our Dev Log, and stay tuned for more! 

See you next month,

Gerdoo Games

notes.title: Dev Log #3 - A Roar-some Update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38705137/78bf48482846b1041c4a167d9dc7fc7d267d2ba1.png[/img]

Welcome to our third Dev Log Jungle Nation! We’re stoked to have you here for our first update of 2022, so let's jump in.

It’s an exciting time for the team, with new character redesigns, UI reworks taking shape, as well as the playtesting of new mechanics! We are also approaching the point where all the different pieces of the game are integrating with each other. It’s so fun and fulfilling to see these combined ideas materialize into a real game! We’re also excited to announce that a major update might come in the Closed Beta, more information below. 

[h1]Art:[/h1]
Our artist has been creating brand new character redesigns, coloring styles/palettes, and animations. Here's a new look into some of the coloring decisions that were finalized that we thought would be cool to show you!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38705137/38bac007fe0976eefc511dc25b957688ad52bc5f.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38705137/aa3f0d51bb58d829cc40e72e29ea14c795e9571c.png[/img]

Hot Take: You might get flashbacks to the [url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Halftone]Halftone Patterns[/url] from a previous Dev Log!

We are also exploring icon designs for different characters. These icons will help us tremendously in making concise, clean, and intuitive presentations, especially when we have to show a lot of game information in a limited space.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38705137/8818669bc0be950074fc9a089152fbb5647b09d5.png[/img]

[h1]Game Design:[/h1]
We’re playtesting new mechanics and features that we want to add to the game. We threw out a few ideas that didn't seem to fit, and we are testing extensively and hammering down the most promising ones. We're not going to talk about the details just yet as we don't want to make any promises, but just so you know, we are looking into new roles, new powers, new voting mechanisms, etc. There is a chance that these new mechanics/features won't make it in the major update, BUT, you'll see them in the subsequent updates that we will push out after. We want RoJ to be a live and evolving game, so we’re counting on our community to keep giving us their valuable feedback to take the game to new heights!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38705137/c0e7be9bbcc9305dc4a8fb1664cea4eff129664d.png[/img]

[h1]UI/UX Rework:[/h1]
We are revamping our Host UI (what you see on the shared screen of the game), to make the overall RoJ experience better for both the host, and players. To give each character more personality, we decided to revisit the player cards for each Bite House member, and make them more thematic by making it look like a video call to President Puma. 

It’s important for us to create a visual language that conveys game information to all players quickly and intuitively, so everyone can just focus on having fun with the gameplay.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38705137/82d4c69708786654bcd5247c3513fbc238032afe.png[/img]

Another challenge we overcame was about the 8+ players game, and especially the 10 players game, where we had limited space to show all the player cards. The first solution we had was to start the design layout from the highest capacity of players, in this case 10, and work backwards from there. We revisited this idea though because it meant sacrificing the 5, 6, and 7 players UI experience a bit. So, as a result, the solution we went for is to give 8+ players games their own UI, a slightly different layout than the 7- player games, which gives all a better visual experience in game! You can see the 7 player layout below:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38705137/7a522364679777adf2dabe08cdc7d7c56577eedd.png[/img]

[h1]Timeline Update:[/h1]
The final integration of different elements in a game is usually an exciting and unpredictable period. With that in mind, we’re really happy with our progress so far and we think we’re on track to launch a version of the redesigned game in Spring 2022!!

We’re also hoping to release a major update to our Closed Beta, so those of you who are lucky enough to snag a Beta key can get a sneak peek sooner, but this will ultimately depend on how well the integration goes.

Previously, we had mentioned that the major update to the Closed Beta will be in Jan/Feb 2022, but we are changing it to TBD. Our focus is to have something concrete for our Spring launch, and pushing an update to the Closed Beta may distract us from that, because it entails an extra round of QA and support. So, in favor of our overall progress, we may delay the major update until we feel confident in the last stages of development. Stay tuned!

In any case, we’re committed to giving an early update to our core community on [url=https://discord.gg/Mg7V8C9E2M]Discord[/url] before releasing it to the broader audience. If you want to follow our development process more closely or have any questions, please feel free to join our [url=https://discord.gg/Mg7V8C9E2M]Discord[/url]!

That’s it for Devlog #3 friends, thanks for coming and for being such dedicated jungle citizens!

See you next month for #4!

GerdooGames

notes.title: Devlog #0 - The Journey So Far and The Road Ahead
notes.content:
[b]A Quick Recap[/b]
During the past few months, a lot of things have changed for us, and for Republic of Jungle. When we quit our jobs to kick off this project, we had some ideas and a rough plan, but you never know where you land with these things. You just have to try your best at every step, learn from mistakes and improve as you go. That was our mentality when we decided to launch a Kickstarter campaign, and when we re-launched it so we could show it at PAX too. As it turns out, in the list of the notoriously exhausting things that a small studio can do, running an expo booth and running a Kickstarter campaign are not far from the top. Doing both simultaneously while an existing campaign is in motion is considered somewhat insane. To be honest, we didn’t know what we were getting into, and it was undoubtedly difficult, but we’re happy to say that it was well worth the effort!
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38705137/c7f2780dac5adc599d1d59e2e43fda66379c019b.png[/img]

[b]A New Beginning[/b]
As a result of our presence on Kickstarter and attendance at PAX, we are now more confident than ever in our project thanks to community members like you that have supported and continue to do so in various ways. Seeing so many people back us, play the game, join our [url=https://discord.gg/Mg7V8C9E2M]Discord [/url]and provide feedback has taken our commitment to the project to the next level. So far, we could only plan for the next immediate step to minimize our risk, but now we have a clearer picture of what we’re building, and we can plan with more confidence. With our Kickstarter stretch goals unlocked, and our team fully focused on production, we are excited to work on things like the new UI/UX, usability features, new artwork, and a lot of polish! In many ways, this is a new beginning for Republic of Jungle.
 
[b]A Strong Foundation[/b]
The current beta of the game is built based on a minimal scope that we felt comfortable with when we started the project. Game development is a risky business and we wanted to be smart and play our cards right, and that’s why we focused on making a playable version rather than a perfect one. We wanted to fail small and learn fast, so we focused on core gameplay and gradually built on top of our prototype based on feedback from our community. Republic of Jungle is a bit of an unconventional game, and it heavily relies on playtests and player feedback to evolve and improve. Now thanks to the support of our community, we are designing a new UI/UX for the game that includes a lot of the exciting ideas proposed during the early stages. 
We are now committed to work on this project long-term, so we are focusing on building a strong foundation first. Game industry at large suffers from rushed plans and product stability issues. Having experience as software engineers in large scale projects, we are fully aware of the challenges that come from unpreparedness in live software production. Therefore, we are taking a moment to assess our goals, build our pipelines, and put systems in place that would help us stay focused on the game instead of fighting fires. A good foundation built with preparedness in mind is going to pay a lot of dividends in the long run.
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38705137/418d8bf5ddb7c2e8184e347090bd9d33e47d89f3.png[/img]

[b]What’s Coming Next[/b]
We are aiming to first release a major update to the current beta that significantly improves the build on top of a  new, and better foundation. It might take a while, but it will be worth the wait. 
Fixing bugs and adding features on top of the current foundation is not sustainable and scalable. Many parts of the game are changing due to the new design, and we want to minimize the risk of doing “throw-away work”. Here are few foundational things we’re working on:
[list]
[*] A more detailed design based on collected feedback to increase focus at the implementation stage
[*] Better development tools and pipelines to allow our team members to stay productive
[*] A better architecture to enable us to add new features faster, and with less risk
[*] Automated tests to help us push updates faster, and more confidently
[*] Better dashboards and alarms for data-driven improvements, adding the opportunity to catch issues early
[/list]
While the current version does not provide the smoothest experience, it has been played thousands of times. It lets our community members enjoy the core loop of the game and its fundamentals. Since this version has been built with simpler assumptions in mind, trying to push updates puts its availability at risk. Therefore, we won’t be pushing bug fixes to the current beta for a while. This lets us stay focused on our top priorities and allows the community to keep playing the game. We will keep track of all reported bugs and feedback and incorporate it in our new designs and implementations, but it will take a while for you to see the actual changes in the game. So, please keep in mind that your input is taken into account even though you may not see it reflected in the beta for a while.
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38705137/306d0a4559b97610075ba53a01e35af33a43d077.png[/img]

[b]Stay Tuned For New Content and Dev Logs[/b]
As we’re working on the new designs and concepts of the game, we will share a summary of our progress here in our dev logs. You can also see WIPs, early designs and artwork in our Discord, or even contribute to development by your feedback and ideas for improvement. Throughout these dev logs, you will gradually see more of the game come to life, until the eventual release of our first major update that will capture a lot of the new content and features we’re adding to the game.
At this time, we don’t have any public estimates on when the major update will be released. As pieces come together, we will start communicating the roadmap in more detail. The best way to stay informed about our progress is to join our [url=https://discord.gg/Mg7V8C9E2M]Discord[/url], follow our social media channels, and follow our future dev logs.
 
Thank you,
Team Gerdoo

notes.title: Our Steam Demo is live!
notes.content:
[b]After months of hard work, we're thrilled to release our PC Demo on Steam.[/b]

Today, our demo goes live as part of Steam Game Festival. It's a good showcase of what we envision for Republic of Jungle, and what we have done so far.

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1413250/Republic_of_Jungle/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38705137/5c68be95866bd68496398653ad9c4a8b30947e83.png[/img][/url]


Some of the new things we're excited to show you:

[list]
[*] Single-player tutorial to teach the basics on your pace
[*] Interactive narrated tutorial to teach new players in the party as the game is played
[*] New character (Katie Cat) voiced by our talented voice actor (Kat!)
[*] New intro with glimpses at the world of Republic of Jungle
[*] New outro and game summary view to show you what happened
[*] Music and sound effects everywhere! (Shout out to Navid and Matheiu)
[*] New artwork, unified artstyle, animations, flavor texts, and more
[*] Our updated Steam page (with new little details for our perceptive fans!)
[/list]

Thank you for being a part of our journey. It'd help us a lot if you check out the game on Steam, wishlist the game, and/or download the demo, tell your friends, and play RoJ with them! 

Have fun,
Moein & Kasra
